scientific_integrity: The theorem is supported by explicit cyclic and matrix Quot charts covering every fixed point. The supplementary finite arithmetic checks are not substitutes for the geometric proof.
scientific_limitations: Complex characteristic zero; framed trivial bundle; length-two Quot scheme; one specified exchange involution. Local quotient types, not a global quotient product. Independent mathematical validation and definitive literature priority not established.
title: Fixed components and quotient singularities of the exceptional length-two Quot involution
